source: 1313 星期日 战技 纸醉金迷 (skill 131302, Skill/Support): 「使指定我方单体角色及其召唤物立即行动…当星期日对「同谐」命途的角色施放该技能时，无法触发立即行动效果。」
note: 「指定我方单体角色**及其召唤物**立即行动」 -- both halves at once, which is why the selector is `target_and_summon` and not `target` plus `summon`: the second word would name THE RULE OWNER's memosprite, not the chosen ally's (M-37). ⚠ `!target has_path 同谐` is the sentence's own exception. It is written as a NEGATION because the DSL's conditions are an AND: the eight Paths that *do* get the advance would otherwise be eight near-identical rules, and a ninth 同谐 one could never be spelled. ⚠ The negation is safe in the direction that matters: `Negated` asks the inner condition for its party first, so a cast with no aimed target FAILS rather than matching by accident (the positive spelling's guarantee, kept). ⚠ `target` is the unit this cast was AIMED AT (M-35), which is what 「指定」 means. ⚠ Self-cast is covered without a rule of its own: Sunday is 同谐 himself, so targeting himself simply fails this condition -- which is what the sentence says. ⚠ NOT authored from this skill: 「对【蒙福者】施放战技后恢复1个技能点」 -- see the rule below (it needed his ultimate's state to exist first).

source: 1313 星期日 战技 纸醉金迷 (skill 131302): 「…并使其造成的伤害提高#2[i]%，若目标拥有召唤物，则造成的伤害提高效果额外提高#4[i]%，持续#3[i]回合。」 param Lv1 = [1, 0.15, 2, 0.25] → #2 = 0.15, #3 = 2 turns, #4 = 0.25
note: The base share (15% at Lv1) for a target that has NO summon. ⚠ Why the two cases are two rules with disjoint conditions (`target_summon_count == 0` here, `>= 1` below) instead of one rule plus a conditional extra: a second `MODIFY_ATTR` of the same attribute on the same target does not ADD, it REPLACES (same kind refreshes -- the 波提欧 16% + 阮·梅 20% = 20% trap), and making them stack with `max_stacks: 2` would stop a recast from refreshing the duration. Disjoint rules give 15% or 40%, with a clean refresh either way. ⚠ `target_summon_count` is the same question 遗器 127 asks of the wearer (`self_summon_count`), asked about the OTHER unit.

source: 1313 星期日 战技 纸醉金迷 (skill 131302): 「…并使其造成的伤害提高#2[i]%，若目标拥有召唤物，则造成的伤害提高效果额外提高#4[i]%，持续#3[i]回合。」 param Lv1 = [1, 0.15, 2, 0.25] → 0.15 + 0.25 = 0.40, stated as ONE number because that is what the target ends up with
note: The same buff when the target DOES have a summon: 15% + 25% = **40%**, written as the sum rather than as two effects (see the note above for why two would replace each other). ⚠ The number is the document's own arithmetic: #2 + #4 = 0.15 + 0.25. ⚠ The buff goes to the PAIR (`target_and_summon`), which is how 「使其造成的伤害提高」 reads after 「及其召唤物」 -- and it is also why the extra share is keyed on the summon existing.

source: 1313 星期日 战技 纸醉金迷 (skill 131302): 「对【蒙福者】施放战技后恢复1个战技点。」
note: The refund: casting this Skill at the ally who already carries his 【蒙福者】 gives the point back. ⚠ `target has_state 蒙福者` is the 「对【蒙福者】施放」 half, and it is the same name the ultimate below writes -- one vocabulary (`APPLY_BUFF` writes it, `has_state` reads it, `REMOVE_STATE` takes it away). ⚠ The engine's ordinary skill-point policy already spends 1 for casting a Skill, so this rule is the refund the sentence describes, not a second grant.

source: 1313 星期日 终结技 轻与伤痕的赞颂 (skill 131303, Ultra/Support): 「…并使目标及其召唤物成为【蒙福者】，【蒙福者】的暴击伤害提高，提高数值等同于星期日#2[i]%暴击伤害+#4[i]%。星期日自身每回合开始时【蒙福者】状态持续回合减1，共持续#3[i]回合。且仅对除星期日自身外终结技最新的施放目标生效。当星期日陷入无法战斗状态时，【蒙福者】效果也会被解除。」 param Lv1 = [0.2, 0.12, 3, 0.08] → #2 = 0.12, #3 = 3 回合, #4 = 0.08
note: Three effects, in the order the sentence needs them. ⚠ **`REMOVE_STATE` first** is 「仅对…**最新的**施放目标生效」: the state goes off everybody, then onto the new pair -- there is no "only one holder" flag, the removal IS that clause. ⚠ **`target != self`** is 「除星期日自身外」: casting it on himself leaves the previous holder alone rather than clearing and re-granting nothing. ⚠ **`ticks_on: "self"` on both buffs** is 「星期日自身每回合开始时…持续回合减1」: the state sits on the ally and is spent by HIS turns (M-42 ④) -- without it the same sentence would last three of the ALLY's turns, which is a different number in every fight. ⚠ **「当星期日陷入无法战斗状态时…解除」 needs no rule**: an anchored buff whose clock will never come again is a leak, so the engine takes it off when the anchor dies (`Battle.releaseBuffsAnchoredToTheDead`, M-42 ③) -- and it COULD not be a rule on him, because `fireTriggers` skips dead units. ⚠ The CRIT DMG is **derived** from his own (`scale: "self_attr:CRIT_ATTACK"`, 12% of it + 8 percentage points, M-42 ①), read when the rule fires and then frozen. ⚠ The first effect is 「恢复等同于#1[f1]%**能量上限**的能量」: `scale: 「target_max_energy」` reads 20% of the ALLY's maximum (his own 130 is irrelevant), which is why it could not be a literal -- the maximum is per character (姬子 120 / 星期日 130 / 翡翠 140). ⚠ It targets `target` (the character), not the pair: the sentence says 「指定我方单体**角色**」, and a memosprite has no energy bar -- asking for a share of one is a loud failure, not a grant of 0.
